final_text: The Signal Source receives the commands on its message input port cmd. A Message Strobe sends {freq: 4200, ampl: 1.2} every 500 ms to a Message Strobe Random, which forwards it to the Signal Source, so the commands set the frequency to 4200 Hz and the amplitude to 1.2. The random strobe's mean period is 100 ms, so on average a command arrives every 100 ms. I did not change the flowgraph.
